name: Staff of Healing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Bard, Cleric, or Druid

last.text: vanishes in a flash of light

summary: 10 charges: Cure Wounds (1 per level, up to 4), Lesser Restoration (2), Mass Cure Wounds (5).
text: Holding this staff, you can spend its charges (10 in all) to cast spells using your spellcasting ability modifier: Lesser Restoration for 2 charges, Mass Cure Wounds for 5, or Cure Wounds for 1 charge per spell level (level 4 at most). It regains 1d6 + 4 charges at dawn each day. If the final charge is used, roll 1d20; a result of 1 makes the staff vanish in a burst of light, gone for good.
